persisted.description: True only when set or migrate completed a real configuration write; false for previews, failures and migration no-ops

editor.description: Editor selected for a configuration edit preview

editor_opened.description: Whether the editor was launched; always false for an edit preview or rejected edit

backup_path.description: Backup file path created during migration

initialized.description: True only when initialization completed, never for a dry run

dry_run.description: Whether initialization, setting, migration or editing is a read-only preview

force.description: Whether initialization selected replacement of existing files

planned_files.description: Configuration paths selected for creation or replacement by init

backup_paths.description: Verified original-file backups retained by real initialization, setting or migration, including after a later failure

rolled_back.description: Whether a failed configuration transaction restored or removed any files it published; also check recovery_required

recovery_required.description: Whether a failed configuration transaction retained its locks and staging because rollback or cleanup could not finish safely
